subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which open linked or adjacent macOS PR should become the canonical fix path for the dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but multiple open PRs overlap the resolver order, dashboard error path, and LaunchAgent env-wrapper source; choosing the combined landing path needs maintainer coordination.

options.title: Review a complete macOS resolver fix
options.body: Prefer a native macOS resolver PR that handles SecretRef-template placeholders, LaunchAgent/service-env fallback, and a dashboard-independent recovery error path.

options.title: Split placeholder and env-wrapper work
options.body: Land the placeholder resolver fix first and keep the LaunchAgent env-wrapper PR separate if maintainers decide those are distinct upgrade paths.

options.title: Queue a replacement only if candidates stall
options.body: Keep this issue open and request a narrow replacement only if the existing linked PRs cannot be brought to a landable state.

recommendation.title: Review a complete macOS resolver fix
recommendation.body: Prefer a native macOS resolver PR that handles SecretRef-template placeholders, LaunchAgent/service-env fallback, and a dashboard-independent recovery error path.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the native macOS dashboard and gateway endpoint surface where the canonical fix would land.
